# Pinned exactly: the Qt build determines the WebEngine resource files
# (v8_context_snapshot.bin, *.pak, icudtl.dat) that the in-place onedir updater
# cannot replace while they are mmap'd. Keeping Qt stable means auto-updates
# stay "same-Qt" (safe). The -Qt6 packages carry the actual Qt/WebEngine
# binaries, so they are pinned too. Bump all four together; the release Qt
# fingerprint is derived automatically from the runtime (scripts/publish_release.ps1).
